verdicts.decision_note: Target-specific implementation claim that enforced royalty behavior is operational on the Base public testnet; no concrete royalty test result supports runtime verification.
The client specifies a $48 flat royalty for secondary sales and requires that charge to be clearly disclosed; all attributes affect product behavior or rendered product content.
The freelancer explicitly confirms the client-originated choice of ERC-721C and OpenSea Creator Controls for marketplace whitelisting and royalty enforcement; no prior replayed keys require removal.
